Name: RRRR The Farmer's Children Standard Art Hair
Author: MoeSharpie
Description: Frustrated how there's no mods on Nexus to accurately depict Your childrens hair in TFC Standard Art for Jello and Shie's Style Portraits for RRRR? I was, too! Now You don't have to be! I edited the hair files from TFC Standard Art's portrait and character folders to accurately depict Your farmers children with Jello and Shie's version of Magnus :) Just download the RRRR folder, unzip it, go into the assets folder of The Farmer's Children Art mod folder, go to Portraits, then drag and click the female and male RRRR preset folders into their respective folders, and You're done! Just rename all folders back to 'RRRR' to simplify the mod config. I can't remember if the standard art already contains RRRR sprite hair presets, so I won't include them, but if it doesn't, I will upload them in the future!
